faq.question: Which element is best for career success?
faq.answer: No element is universally superior. Success depends on alignment between your dominant element, luck cycles, and chosen industry.

faq.question: Can I change my element type?
faq.answer: Your natal element structure cannot change, but you can choose environments and strategies that harmonize with it.

content.text: In Bazi, your dominant element reflects how you process decisions, handle pressure, and pursue opportunities.
Wood favors growth and creativity. Fire seeks visibility and influence. Earth values stability. Metal prioritizes structure. Water excels in strategy and adaptability.
Career success increases when your professional environment supports your elemental strengths rather than constantly opposing them.
Luck pillars and elemental cycles activate different career phases, amplifying or challenging your natural strengths.
